# A `payment:` block written under an `open` line.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. Under an `open` line only the account's
# keys and its `open_prepayment:` blocks are read, so the file is refused at
# line 16 before anything in it is carried out.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_only_keys_and_open_prepayment_blocks_are_read_under_an_open_line.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	payment:
		amount: 5.00 CAD
